name: @clikdeploy/clikrouter
description: Provider-agnostic AI request normalization and router-selection logic: one dialect layer across ~40 providers (registry, request building, response extraction) plus the candidate-ranking algorithm. No storage, no credentials, no platform-specific business logic — those stay in the app that wires this up (see @clikdeploy/platform-domains's connectors for ClikDeploy's own Redis/Postgres-backed wiring: live latency/cost EWMAs, cooldowns, credential resolution, billing attribution).
//exports: This package is consumed AS SOURCE (no build step), so `main` alone left every
SUBPATH unresolvable by Node: `@clikdeploy/clikrouter/ai-provider-registry` — which the
four platform-domains connectors shims re-export from — resolved to a bare directory
entry that does not exist. tsconfig `paths` hid that from tsc and from the Next build,
so the only place it surfaced was vitest, as a COLLECTION failure: every suite whose
import graph reached the AI-router surface was dropped without running. That was
patched three times, once per consuming vitest.config.ts, and the two configs nobody
thought of (packages/ai-assistant, packages/domain-core) silently lost 49 tests.
An `exports` map fixes it once, where the defect is, and needs no alias anywhere.
`./*` maps to `./src/*.ts` to mirror the tsconfig `paths` entry every consumer already
agree by construction instead of by everyone remembering to update both.
